name: Mark of Belial
source:
You are a police officer who is hunting a ruthless serial killer that the media has dubbed Belial. He leaves large marks all over his crime scenes and always leaves the bodies in a grotesque manner.

[From [url=https://electricpuke.itch.io/mark-of-belial]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名警察，正在追捕一名被媒体称为“贝利”的残酷连环杀手。他在犯罪现场留下了巨大的痕迹，并且总是以怪诞的方式留下尸体。

[来自[url=https://electricpuke.itch.io/mark-of-belial]itch.io[/url]]
